# Munder Difflin procedural characters

Source: https://github.com/chaitanyagiri/munder-difflin
Pinned commit: `c7c8921f4491104d342861e32fa214e486442304`.

`portraitArt.ts` is adapted from `src/renderer/src/office/portraitArt.ts`; MIT copyright (c) 2026 Chaitanya Giri, license retained next to the file. The type-only cast dependency is inlined. HQ uses its procedural scene-frame pixels, selected with stable identity hashes. No external sprite sheets, LimeZu art, maps, Pixi renderer, updater or runtime was copied.

HQ's SVG floor, CSS furniture, status adapter and controls are original AGPL integration. Agent Teams AI's separate existing graph remains the Team map view.
